title: CORRIGENDUM NOTIFICATION OF AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT OFFICER(ADO)
text:
KEY LINES:
In continuation to the Commission's Advertisement No. PSC-R(Ay141 2020

FULL TEXT:
ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No.PSC-R (1t) I t 4 12020 : : Dated Itanagar, the 28th July' 2021.
In continuation to the Commission's Advertisement No. PSC-R(Ay141 2020
Dated 28th December'Z}2}, it is to inform that in the Advertisement for the Post of
Agriculture Development Officer (ADO), it was inadvertently mentioned as Recruitment Test
(Objective type) will be on General Knowledge of 100 Marks.
Whereas, ADO being Technical Post, Recruitment Test will consists of
Technical Subjects from both the Syllabus of Agriculture Paper -I and Paper -II (Objective
types) carrying 100 Marks. The duration of the Recruitment Test will be of 2(two) hours.
The Recruitment Test will be conducted on 19th September'2021. The venues
of examination and downloading of Admit Card will be notified in due course.
